question: For weekly-sales data, I need an analysis of our sales performance around mid-June for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020. Specifically, calculate the percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 and the four weeks following June 15 for each year.
sql:
WITH week_selection AS (
  SELECT 
    2018 AS year,
    '2018-06-18' as ref_week,
    '2018-05-21' as before1, '2018-05-28' as before2, '2018-06-04' as before3, '2018-06-11' as before4,
    '2018-06-18' as after1, '2018-06-25' as after2, '2018-07-02' as after3, '2018-07-09' as after4
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    2019, '2019-06-17',
    '2019-05-20', '2019-05-27', '2019-06-03', '2019-06-10',
    '2019-06-17', '2019-06-24', '2019-07-01', '2019-07-08'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    2020, '2020-06-15',
    '2020-05-18', '2020-05-25', '2020-06-01', '2020-06-08',
    '2020-06-15', '2020-06-22', '2020-06-29', '2020-07-06'
)
SELECT 
  year,
  ref_week,
  SUM(CASE WHEN week_date = before1 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as before1_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN week_date = before2 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as before2_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN week_date = before3 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as before3_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN week_date = before4 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as before4_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN week_date = after1 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as after1_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN week_date = after2 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as after2_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN week_date = after3 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as after3_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN week_date = after4 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as after4_sales
FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
CROSS JOIN week_selection
WHERE cleaned_weekly_sales.calendar_year = week_selection.year
GROUP BY year, ref_week, before1, before2, before3, before4, after1, after2, after3, after4
ORDER BY year
